summary: The drawer layout and components render cleanly with consistent spacing, but the dismiss hint text in the footer specifies an incorrect drag gesture direction.

issues.title: Incorrect gesture hint direction
issues.description: Footer text directs users to drag left to dismiss a right-anchored drawer.
issues.evidence: Footer text displays 'Drag the sheet left or press Escape to dismiss.'
issues.suggestion: Update copy to 'Drag the sheet right or press Escape to dismiss.'
